metadata.llm_reason: Candidate 74c38398-9ffa-5ed2-ba5e-96900a42bd3a (Decorator-Based Span Instrumentation) is a narrower, more specific instantiation of the existing skill a1a7e0ae-7044-57cb-acba-af065d511fe0 (Decorator-based Observability Instrumentation). Both target the same semantic capability: applying decorators from agentops.sdk.decorators for span/observability instrumentation. The candidate focuses on span lifecycle management while the existing skill covers the broader decorator pattern (@workflow, @agent, @operation). The candidate should merge into the existing skill rather than create a duplicate capability.
